task_description: Implement chat and terminal features in the adadex conversation tab: composer enhancements (Tab-to-queue, Escape×2 stop, Ctrl+Enter interrupt-and-send, Ctrl+G expanded, stash prompt, play button for pending), Chat/Terminal tab switching with Alt+G shortcut and model pill, and reading enhancements (per-message menu, text selection Reply, view modes, Cmd+F search focus).

verification.summary: 167 tests pass (43 test files). TypeScript check exits 0. 28 new tests added across 3 new test files. Tests exercise actual component behavior: keyboard shortcuts in ConversationComposer call correct callbacks, viewMode prop changes suppress/expose WorkSummary in ConversationChatThread, per-message menu shows role-appropriate actions in ConversationTurnBubble. The pending-message play button test uses a simplified harness but the actual implementation is verified in ConversationsPrimaryView.tsx lines 434 and 646-648. Environment constraint: vitest must always run with --configLoader=runner flag due to macOS sandbox blocking writes to apps/web/node_modules/.vite-temp/.
